subject: Signature verification failing
customer_question: Our HMAC never matches the signature header. We followed the docs exactly. What are we doing wrong?
resolution_notes: Told them to hash raw bytes. Did not help. Escalated to TCE, turned out to be the header/algorithm change. Took 4 days.

subject: Which header carries the signature?
customer_question: Docs say X-Nametag-Signature but we only receive Nametag-Signature. Which is correct?
resolution_notes: Confirmed the new header is correct. Docs are stale.

subject: Duplicate webhook deliveries
customer_question: We processed the same verification twice and double-charged an internal workflow. Why are we getting duplicates and how do we stop it?
resolution_notes: Pointed to event_id dedupe in the v2 release notes. Customer had never seen the release notes.

subject: How many times do you retry?
customer_question: Your docs say 3 retries over 15 minutes. Our logs show attempts more than 6 hours after the original event. Which is it?
resolution_notes: Confirmed 8 attempts over 24 hours. Docs wrong.

subject: What is Nametag-Timestamp for?
customer_question: There is a Nametag-Timestamp header in every request that is not documented anywhere. Can we ignore it?
resolution_notes: Explained it is part of the signed string and should be checked for replay protection.

subject: Are events delivered in order?
customer_question: We receive verification.started and verification.completed for the same subject. Can we rely on receiving them in the order they occurred, or do we need to sequence them ourselves?
resolution_notes: No documented answer. Asked engineering, no response yet. Ticket aging.

subject: Endpoint behind our WAF
customer_question: Deliveries are 403ing. Do you publish source IPs we can allowlist?
resolution_notes: Sent the egress ranges from the internal runbook. Customer asked why this is not on the docs site.

subject: How do we stop receiving events?
customer_question: We decommissioned a service but events keep arriving for weeks. Deleting the endpoint in the Console did not seem to take effect immediately.
resolution_notes: Explained 410 Gone stops retries and disables the endpoint. Not documented anywhere customer-facing.

subject: Payload shape changed unexpectedly
customer_question: Our parser broke overnight. The event field is gone and there is now a type field and a data object. We were not notified.
resolution_notes: v1 sunset hit on 2026-08-01 as announced in the v2 release notes. Customer never received or read them.

subject: Test event succeeds but live events never arrive
customer_question: Send Test Event works. We have never received a real verification event.
resolution_notes: Event type selection issue. They had only selected verification.started.

subject: Docs gave our AI assistant the wrong answer
customer_question: We built our verification from an AI assistant that cited your documentation. The algorithm and header it described do not exist. See attached transcript.
resolution_notes: Root cause is the stale signature section on the public docs page. Escalated internally.

subject: Can we replay a failed event?
customer_question: An event dead-lettered while our endpoint was down. Is it gone or can we get it back?
resolution_notes: Delivery log retains dead-lettered events for 7 days and supports replay. Documented internally only.
